note: The machine-checked half of docs/RUNS.md. Empty on purpose: no run of this corpus by anyone else has been posted with a link that resolves, so there is nothing to transcribe. An empty table is a statement about us, not about the corpus. tools/check_external_runs.py refuses a row that calls itself 'independent' instead of blind or directed, refuses a blind claim that also records reading our vectors, refuses a figure that has been normalised into a percentage or into a fraction of a different corpus, and refuses tallies that do not equal the rows above them.
